subpages.text: Home About Us Our Verticals AI Infra E-Waste Case Studies News Careers Contact Get a Quote About Sheeltron 35+ years mastering the complete IT lifecycle. Founded in 1990, Sheeltron Digital Systems is India's only company that handles the full lifecycle of enterprise IT — from first deployment to final decommission. Sheeltron Digital Systems Pvt Ltd (SDSPL) was founded in 1990 in Bangalore, India with a singular vision: to be the one partner an enterprise needs for its entire IT infrastructure journey. Over 35+ years, we've grown from a regional IT products company to a full-lifecycle infrastructure partner with offices in 7 cities across India , a CPCB-certified e-waste facility in Tumkur, Karnataka , and a global reach spanning 120+ countries . Our OEM partnerships with HPE, AMD, Seagate, Dell, NVIDIA, ASUS, Gigabyte, Juniper, Aruba, Lenovo, Samsung, Western Digital, Micron, Cisco, and Microsoft aren't logos on a wall. They're deep engineering relationships built over decades that give our clients priority access, competitive pricing, and direct escalation paths. We serve CIOs, IT Heads, and Procurement Directors at enterprises across banking, government, healthcare, telecom, manufacturing, and education sectors. Our Journey 1990 Founded in Bangalore Sheeltron Digital Systems established as an enterprise IT products distributor, partnering with leading global OEMs from day one. Late 1990s Pan-India expansion Opened offices across major Indian metros, building a nationwide deployment and support network covering 7 cities. 2000s Managed services launch Evolved from products to services — 24/7 infrastructure management, break-fix, AMC, and proactive monitoring with HPE Master ASE certified engineers. 2010s E-waste & sustainability Opened CPCB-certified e-waste processing
